data.title: 玛露希尔 · 营地里的香草面包
data.description: 营地午休，玛露希尔穿苔绿短斗篷和赭色长衫，坐在木箱上把一小片香草面包掰开。她先谨慎闻一闻，再把温热的断面转向日光，尖耳与挑起的眉一起显出终于放心的好奇。
data.action: 掰开香草面包，闻过后对着光检查松软内里。
data.promptProse: Marcille Donato sits on the camp supply box in a moss-green cape and rust tunic, breaking a small herb loaf and cautiously smelling its warm center. She turns the crumb toward daylight, raised brows and pointed ears showing reassurance. Cream trousers and brown boots remain practical in the medium view. Soft midday shade reveals blonde braids and bread texture, with gentler reflected light from the ground and dark gaps between the box boards.
